meta.name: abductive-hypothesis-generation
meta.description: Strategy: Inference to the best explanation in the face of anomalies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据异常现象生成最佳解释假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在研究或分析中从异常现象推导出合理假设。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to derive plausible hypotheses from anomalies in research or analysis.

howto.what: 当你描述一个现有理论无法解释的异常现象时，Claude 会系统性地生成多种候选解释，并按合理性排序，选出最可信的一个作为假设，同时保留其他竞争假设。
howto.when: 当你提到一个与现有理论预测不符的异常结果，或需要从多个竞争解释中选择最值得验证的一个时触发。

say.text: 这个实验结果很奇怪，和理论预测不符，可能的原因是什么？
say.note: Claude 会启动生成候选解释并排序。

say.text: 我观察到数据异常，帮我生成几个可能的假设。
say.note: Claude 会按照四步流程生成并排序假设。

say.text: 现有理论无法解释这个现象，哪个解释最合理？
say.note: Claude 会选出最佳解释并保留竞争假设。

howto.what_en: When you describe an anomaly that existing theory cannot explain, Claude systematically generates candidate explanations, ranks them by plausibility, selects the best one as a hypothesis, and retains competing hypotheses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention an anomalous result inconsistent with theoretical predictions, or need to select the most worth-testing explanation among several competing ones.

say_en.text: This experiment result is strange and contradicts theory. What could be the reasons?
say_en.note: Claude will generate and rank candidate explanations.

say_en.text: I observed data anomalies. Help me generate several possible hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude follows the four-step abduction flow.

say_en.text: Existing theory can't explain this phenomenon. Which explanation is most plausible?
say_en.note: Claude selects the best hypothesis and keeps competitors.
